title: Three Evenings and One Short Ring
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：key　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 key 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the caretaker ① turned the key that no stranger in the hallway would have recorded, and he said the turning was the whole of the Monday. The ② key, meaning the lock itself and not the ring, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a key, he said, is the only thing in a hallway that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ key in that hallway had the same short ring beside it, and the ④ key at the far door, meaning the copy they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A key, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the caretaker said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the key was the whole of the matter, meaning the way and not the lock. The ⑥ key, meaning the way and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; key, he said, is either something you turn or the only word that means both a lock and a way. He said the way is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ key had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short ring. The ⑧ key of the whole thing, the caretaker wrote in April, was one hallway and three Mondays of recording; key, he said, is either the copy at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ key I remember is the lock recorded in the log, which closed in 1990 and is still recorded as the quietest in the hallway. A ⑩ key, my mother said in 1992, is the only lock that improves by being recorded; every key, she said, is a way that has agreed to look like a lock. She said the way was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 钥匙；关键（指门厅里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 钥匙；关键（指那把钥匙本身，与钥匙环相对）
C. 固定搭配：turn the key 转动这把钥匙
D. n. 钥匙；关键（指留给孩子们收着的一把那一把）
E. n. 出入之事（抽象总称，指一处门厅的钥匙之事）
F. n. 钥匙；关键（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一把）
G. n. 门路、关键（指一件事里人人都开却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 关键（抽象总称，指人人都开却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: turned the key that no stranger in the hallway would have recorded
The key, meaning the lock itself and not the ring
the key at the far door
the key was the whole of the matter
the key had become a line in a log
The key of the whole thing
A key, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: turn the key 意为“转动这把钥匙”，1983 年那位看门人把门厅里没有一位陌生人肯记录的一把钥匙做了一遍。
key 意为“钥匙；关键”，指那把钥匙本身而不是钥匙环，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
key 意为“钥匙；关键”，指门厅里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一个小小的钥匙环。
key 意为“钥匙；关键”，指最远那扇门口留给孩子们收着的一把那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
key 意为“门路、关键”，指一件事里人人都开却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个门路就是那件事的全部。
key 意为“关键”，指人人都开却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把钥匙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
key 意为“钥匙；关键”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一把，到 1988 年这一把成了记录里的一行。
key 意为“出入之事”，看门人四月写道，整件事的钥匙之事是一处门厅和三个星期一的记录。
key 意为“钥匙；关键”，我记得的是记录里记录过的那一把，1990 年配好了，至今仍被说成门厅里最安静的一把。
key 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，钥匙是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的钥匙。
